title: Learning to Trust: Dynamic Utilization of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for E-commerce Search Relevance
authors: Tingqiao Xu; Shaowei Yao; Chenhe Dong; Yiming Jin; Zerui Huang; Dan Ou; Haihong Tang; Bo Zheng
